title: MultiAgentNetBase duplicates the agent dimensions when in centralized mode
author: Gilnore

comments.author: Xmaster6y
comments.body:
Hey, 
What do you mean by "old pytorch neural net"?
Otherwise, did you have a look at how it's done in `MultiAgentMLP`? It is based on `MLP`, a basic `torch` net class.

comments.author: Gilnore
comments.body:
> Hey, What do you mean by "old pytorch neural net"? Otherwise, did you have a look at how it's done in `MultiAgentMLP`? It is based on `MLP`, a basic `torch` net class.

The words were “regular old PyTorch neural network”. By which I mean any default torch.nn.module. 

I read the implementation in the multi-agent MLP, it seems that it went and flattened the input along some dimensions before feeding into the multi-agent base under central mode. 

Is it something that must be done for any multi-agent framework under central mode?

comments.author: Gilnore
comments.body: I gave the multi-agent MLP another read through, it seems to just flattened the agents dimension into the features dimensions. Would this cause problems? Under centralized, all agents are able to observe all the states and respond, would they just all return the same output? If so how would this differ from a single agent system?

comments.author: Gilnore
comments.body: I’ve realized it is likely not a bug.  I’ve been trying out the multi-agent ppo guide, and I was a little confused on what the purpose of using multiple agents would be, of parameters are shared and centralized is true.
